AdminReservations.title: Reservations
AdminReservations.subtitle: Temporary holds created at checkout. A hold is released automatically at expiry after the payment provider has been checked.
AdminReservations.releaseConfirm: Release this hold? The provider is checked first; a paid or in-progress payment is never released.

errors.NOT_ACTIVE: This hold is no longer active.

errors.PAYMENT_IN_PROGRESS: A payment is in progress at the provider. Try again later.
